name: Machine Incline Chest Press
steps: Adjust the incline press seat so the handles align with your upper chest and sit with both feet flat.
Set your upper back against the pad and grip the handles with your wrists straight and elbows just below shoulder level.
Press the handles forward and upward along the machine track until your arms are extended without forcefully locking your elbows.
Return the handles slowly back to a controlled stretch across your upper chest.
tips: Keep your shoulder blades retracted against the pad so your upper chest drives the press.
Avoid lifting your glutes or arching your lower back sharply off the backrest.
